title: Studio proposes swapping a poster for a flyer
brief:
Client: Velvet Acorn Ceramics; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A2 exhibition poster using the supplied title and images.
Supply a print-ready PDF and a 1200 px web JPEG of the poster.
Two revision rounds cover changes within the poster layout.
Proof is due 25 October; final files are due 30 October.
Out of scope: flyers, invitations and additional artwork sizes; substitutions require agreement.
message: Plans have changed a little. Could we skip the poster, do a flyer instead? Happy to talk through the size and whether this changes the fee.
